name: @floez-werk/pi-extension-release-tool
description: Release tooling for FloezWerk pi extensions: scaffolding, README release-notes sync, GitHub release notes and the shared CI/CD workflows.
author: FloezWerk

scripts.check: npm run check:readme && npm run check:syntax && npm run check:yaml && npm run check:self && npm run check:pack
scripts.check:yaml: for f in .github/workflows/*.yml template/.github/workflows/*.yml; do npx -y js-yaml@4 "$f" > /dev/null || exit 1; done && echo "workflows parse"
scripts.check:syntax: node --check tooling/cli.mjs && node --check tooling/readme-block.mjs && node --check tooling/changelog-section.mjs && node --check tooling/scaffold.mjs && node --check tooling/self-test.mjs && node --check tooling/check-pack.mjs
